author: Coco_stag
body:
Hello avicus,

I have 2 more suggestions, lez get started.

[SUG] Voting maps

There are maps on avicus that have different gamemodes for example Rendezvous. It has CTH, DTM ect.
For those type of maps that have more than 1 gamemode there should be a voting thingy. It says CTH or DTM and they choose what tthey want. The one with the most counts gets their choice. (Not a fan of this idea)

[SUG] Sell your badges

I was aiming for the omegabadge I was at 88k and I already had a 12k badge bought. If I could of sold it I would of been at it quicker. Please let us get refunds or make the refund half price. Thanks!

replies.body:
Selling Badges and getting the full price is not smart. It could be brought down to a 1/4th of the real price. For this instance, if you would sell the 12k badge, it would give you back 3k credits.


Also Gamemode voting isn't really that smart. Players will pick DTM because of the amount of players who play that GM.
